ratio_decidendi: An unexplained delay of over 24 hours in lodging the First Information Report (FIR) in a capital offence (Section 302 PPC) raises genuine suspicion of deliberation, consultation, and false implication. Such unexplained delay entitles the accused to the concession of post-arrest bail under Section 497(2) CrPC as a case of further inquiry.
facts_summary: The petitioner was implicated in a homicide case under Section 302/34 PPC. The occurrence took place in daylight, yet the FIR was registered after a delay of 36 hours without any explanation by the complainant or investigating officer.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے (سیکشن 302) میں ایف آئی آر کے اندراج میں بغیر کسی معقول وجہ کے 24 گھنٹے سے زیادہ تاخیر مشاورت اور جھوٹے نامزد کیے جانے کا شبہ پیدا کرتی ہے، جس کی بنا پر ملزم سیکشن 497(2) ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت ضمانت بعد از گرفتاری کا حقدار بن جاتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Grant of bail in non-bailable offences not falling within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC is a matter of right and refusal is an exception. Even in offences falling within the prohibitory clause, if there are reasonable grounds for believing that the accused has not committed a non-bailable offence, but that there are sufficient grounds for further inquiry into his guilt under Section 497(2) CrPC, bail cannot be withheld as punishment.
facts_summary: Landmark ruling reiterating the cardinal principles governing grant and refusal of post-arrest bail, emphasizing that pre-trial detention cannot be converted into advance punishment.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(1) ضابطہ فوجداری کی امتناعی شق سے باہر جرائم میں ضمانت اصول ہے اور انکار استثناء۔ مقدمے کے اس مرحلے پر ملزم کو جیل میں رکھ کر قبل از وقت سزا نہیں دی جا سکتی۔

case_title: Shahzada Qaiser Arfat v. The State
ratio_decidendi: For the grant of pre-arrest bail under Section 498 CrPC, the applicant must establish ulterior motives, malice, or mala fides on the part of the complainant or the police to humiliate, harass, or cause unjustified incarceration. Where false implication is apparent on the face of the record, pre-arrest bail must be confirmed.
facts_summary: Petitioner sought confirmation of pre-arrest bail in a case involving property dispute where the complainant falsely registered a criminal FIR to exert pressure.
urdu_ratio: قبل از گرفتاری ضمانت (سیکشن 498 ضابطہ فوجداری) کی منظوری کے لیے مدعی یا پولیس کی بدنیتی (Mala Fide) اور بے گناہ شخص کو رسوا کرنے کی کوشش کا ثابت ہونا لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under the third proviso to Section 497(1) CrPC, an accused who has been in continuous custody for a period exceeding two years in offences punishable with death, and whose trial has not concluded, is entitled to statutory bail as of right, provided the delay in trial is not occasioned by any act or omission of the accused.
facts_summary: The accused remained behind bars for over 26 months without conclusion of trial in a murder case. The delay was attributed entirely to prosecution witnesses and police non-appearance.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(1) ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت اگر ملزم مسلسل 2 سال سے زائد جیل میں ہو اور ٹرائل میں تاخیر ملزم کی وجہ سے نہ ہوئی ہو، تو وہ قانونی بنیاد پر (Statutory Ground) ضمانت کا حقدار ہے۔

case_title: Sughran Bibi v. The State (Larger Bench)
ratio_decidendi: There can be only one First Information Report (FIR) in respect of one occurrence. Registration of a second or subsequent FIR regarding the same incident is illegal and without jurisdiction. Any counter-version or subsequent statement must be recorded by the investigating officer under Section 161 CrPC during the same investigation.
facts_summary: 7-member larger bench of the Supreme Court authoritative judgment resolving the law on multiple FIRs in a single criminal incident.
urdu_ratio: ایک ہی وقوعے کی دوسری ایف آئی آر درج نہیں کی جا سکتی۔ مخالف فریق کا بیان یا نیا مؤقف اسی تفتیش کے دوران سیکشن 161 ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت ریکارڈ کیا جائے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: Where there is an irreconcilable conflict between the ocular testimony (eye-witness statements) and medical evidence regarding the distance of firing, nature of injuries, or time of death in a Section 302 PPC case, the benefit of doubt must inevitably be extended to the accused, resulting in acquittal.
facts_summary: Eye-witnesses claimed accused shot deceased from point-blank range, whereas post-mortem and forensic report showed absence of blackening/charring and long-range bullet trajectory.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے (سیکشن 302) میں چشم دید گواہوں کے بیانات اور میڈیکل رپورٹ کے درمیان واضح تضاد کی صورت میں شک کا فائدہ لازمی طور پر ملزم کو دیا جائے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: To award death penalty as Qisas under Section 302(a) PPC, the strict standard of proof under Article 17 of Qanun-e-Shahadat Order, 1984 (Tazkiya-tul-Shahood) must be satisfied. Where proof required for Qisas is lacking, punishment can only be awarded under Section 302(b) PPC as Tazir.
facts_summary: Detailed Supreme Court judgment distinguishing the evidentiary thresholds required for imposing death as Qisas versus Tazir under Pakistani criminal jurisprudence.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 302(a) کے تحت قصاص کی سزا کے لیے تزکیۃ الشہود کا سخت اسلامی معیار پورا ہونا ضروری ہے، ورنہ سزا سیکشن 302(b) کے تحت بطور تعزیر دی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Recovery of the crime weapon at the instance of the accused is merely a corroborative piece of evidence and cannot be treated as substantive evidence to sustain a conviction under Section 302 PPC when the primary ocular evidence has been discarded.
facts_summary: Prosecution relied solely on the recovery of a pistol after eye-witnesses were found untrustworthy. Supreme Court held recovery alone cannot establish murder charge.
urdu_ratio: آلۂ قتل کی برآمدگی محض تائیدی ثبوت ہے، اگر بنیادی چشم دید گواہ غیر معتبر قرار پائیں تو صرف برآمدگی کی بنیاد پر قتل کی سزا نہیں دی جا سکتی۔

case_title: Justice Qazi Faez Isa v. President of Pakistan
statutes_cited: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973 - Article 10A
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973 - Article 9
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973 - Article 14
ratio_decidendi: Article 10A of the Constitution guarantees the fundamental right to a fair trial and due process in the determination of civil rights and obligations or in any criminal charge. Any state action, investigation, or executive order violating transparency, natural justice, or surveillance without judicial warrant violates Articles 9, 10A, and 14.
facts_summary: Landmark constitutional judgment by full court upholding inviolability of judicial independence and strict observance of due process under Article 10A.
urdu_ratio: آئین کا آرٹیکل 10A ہر شہری کو شفاف ٹرائل اور فیئر ٹرائل کا بنیادی حق دیتا ہے۔ قانونی تقاضوں اور عدالتی حکم کے بغیر کی جانے والی کارروائی غیر آئینی ہے۔

case_title: Ghulam Hussain v. Station House Officer (SHO)
statutes_cited: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973 - Article 199
ratio_decidendi: The High Court under Article 199 of the Constitution has constitutional authority to protect citizens against unlawful police harassment, illegal confinement, and abuse of official power by law enforcement agencies. However, for registration of an FIR, the citizen should first approach the Ex-Officio Justice of Peace under Section 22-A / 22-B CrPC.
facts_summary: Supreme Court laid down comprehensive guidelines for High Courts in entertaining Article 199 petitions against police authorities.
urdu_ratio: آئین کے آرٹیکل 199 کے تحت ہائی کورٹ پولیس کی غیر قانونی ہراسانی اور اختیارات کے ناجائز استعمال کے خلاف شہریوں کو تحفظ دینے کی مجاز ہے۔

case_title: Mian Allah Ditta v. The State
ratio_decidendi: To constitute an offence under Section 489-F PPC, the prosecution must prove two indispensable ingredients: (i) the cheque was issued with dishonest intent, and (ii) it was issued towards repayment of a loan or fulfillment of an existing obligation. A post-dated cheque issued merely as guarantee or security in a business transaction does not automatically attract criminal liability under Section 489-F PPC.
facts_summary: Dispute over dishonored cheque issued as collateral security in a commercial contract. Supreme Court granted bail emphasizing civil nature of dispute.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 489-F تعزیرات پاکستان کے تحت جرم ثابت کرنے کے لیے بدنیتی اور قرض کی واپسی لازمی عنصر ہیں۔ محض سیکیورٹی یا گارنٹی کے چیک پر فوجداری مقدمہ نہیں بنتا۔

ratio_decidendi: Where the allegations in the FIR, even if taken at face value, disclose a purely civil dispute arising out of breach of contract without any fraudulent or dishonest inception, the criminal machinery cannot be invoked to arm-twist the other party. In such cases, the High Court is bound to quash the FIR under Section 561-A CrPC to prevent abuse of the process of court.
facts_summary: Complainant lodged FIR under Section 420 PPC for non-delivery of goods under a commercial agreement. High Court quashed the criminal proceedings.
urdu_ratio: اگر ایف آئی آر کے مندرجات خالصتاً دیوانی (Civil) نوعیت کے ہوں تو فوجداری کارروائی عدالت کے عمل کا ناجائز استعمال ہے، جسے سیکشن 561-A ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت خارج (Quash) کیا جا سکتا ہے۔
